# Google Surveys

> > Google Surveys and Google Opinion Rewards provide survey and opinion-polling platforms with sunset guidance and migration resources for publishers and users.

Google Surveys is a survey platform that has been sunset, with resources for data migration, refunds, and transition to alternative products. The site also promotes Google Opinion Rewards, a mobile app for users to earn rewards by sharing feedback and opinions.

## Key Topics

- Google Surveys
- Google Opinion Rewards
- Surveys 360
- Product Sunset
- Data Access
- Migration Guide
- Refund Policy
- Mobile Surveys
- Rewards Program
- Survey App
- Opinion Polling
- End-of-Life
- Google Ads
- Looker Studio
- Payment Options

## Product Sunset & Migration

- [Google Surveys Sunset - Google Surveys Help](https://surveys.google.com): Google Surveys and Surveys 360 sunset notice with FAQ, data access, and migration guidance.
- [Google Surveys Sunset - Publisher Guidance](http://surveys.google.com/publisher/landing): Publisher-focused sunset information for Google Surveys with migration and refund guidance.

## Google Opinion Rewards

- [Google Opinion Rewards - It Pays to Share Your Opinion](https://surveys.google.com/google-opinion-rewards/): Google Opinion Rewards app overview: mobile surveys, rewards program, and payment options.
